findings.description: The restored North Dutch Windmill was rededicated on Saturday, November 14, 1981. Of its $224,000 cost, Eleanor Rossi Crabtree, who had pursued its restoration for fifteen years, raised $117,000, and eighteen Seabees of the Reserve Naval Mobile Construction Battalion Two had given their labor since June 1976; plaques honored both.
